data.body: Additional organic-run stocktake: run 31892203411 passed in 31m59s with negligible 2-4s queues. macOS job 30m18s; default 25m45s; integration 2m35s. No individual test exceeded 30s; top macOS nodes were attestation-signing fallback 26.11s and the N=3000 import benchmark 23.06s. Ubuntu default/integration: 419.68/76.22s, 468.30/86.96s, 637.29/83.10s. Total successful-job occupancy 72m48s. The exact ref was change 1809 PS3 250c623334 with parent 588d7df0bd, so neither 8f9 nor 0f34 is its ancestor; do not count it toward current-code steady-state average. The run is still useful evidence that >30m successes can arise from broad macOS throughput degradation without queue delay or an individual >=30s test.
